reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:43631bd3cec0d5d44c43c69fc37e881d]] When I first saw the hair I was worried it wasn't enough. But when you open it, there's more than it seems. I'm so pleased with this hair. I will surely order this again especially since it's 9 bundles. The hair is just like described. And it came with a crochet hook. Thanks!

This was my first time ever doing box braids on my hair and it did it myself. The hair was easy to manage and well packaged. I love the quantity. I got 9 packs and used 5 packs for my 20in hair.  Definitely my go to for my hair.

Love the package, came with a crochet hook.. I thought it wouldn't be enough hair.. so I order 2 packs.. and I only use 4 packs, so I am able to do my head at least 3 more times before order more hair. The texture is amazing and it give you a more natural look. No weird smell from the hair. Came very quickly. Didnt like the way it was in hot water.. its sweels up alot more then I thought it would but it still came out very cute. Does get tangle a little bit.  This hair is alot stronger then most

The hair is soft and I was able to do my whole head in medium box braids and have 2 packs left. However, the hair tangled like no other. Once I got beyond that and finally finished my hair, I went to seal it as I always do. It melted 😳 Now I have to cut the ends off and figure out what to do so the ends don't unravel. I definitely will not be buying this hair again; even for the price.
Absolutely involve with this hair. No smell, good quality and did my whole head.

My daughter got her hair braided and loved the hair texture and color . She loves that it has body , didnt have an odor and it's super softness.  Her Omg thanks mom was all I needed to know that the product was great ! We definitely will be purchasing again  !
Simply put beautiful, soft, natural shine and zero smell.

This prestretched braided hair is the boom 💥.  Pros: Just as described  1. It really does stretch  2. Light weight  3. Best  Value for the bucks- 9 packs.  4. Soft  5. Very little to no knots.  Cons One might assume the amount given may not complete the entire head- but it did.  I was impressed with the outcome . I did not have a heavy amount of hair on my head-breaking my neck, or making it difficult to style in a bun.I’m Very pleased. I would definitely order again.

The quality and softness of the hair are great. I bought this hair because I’m doing a lot of protective styles in my daughters hair during this pandemic. My only con is that I wish the packs of hair had more in each one, the packs are smaller than what I was expecting.

You can’t beat this. Great quality hair, 9 packs of great soft thick hair. I was able to do my own knotless braids and use this hair because it did not tangle easily like lots of other braiding hair. I would buy this hair again and again! I’m in love.

reviews.t: The quality is ok, the quantity is minimal
reviews.x: I did like that the hair is soft, did not tangle, pre stretched and did good with the hot water... I don’t like that the packages of hair was thin... I feel like I could get a better price and quantity from my local beauty supply store....

reviews.t: Essential for all your braiding needs
reviews.x: This hair is great. No smell, no tangle. I am very please with the quality and it finishes very well. I get a lot of compliments. And will definitely buy again. Recommending this hair to everyone.

reviews.t: Nice price for braiding hair. Thick.
reviews.x: Used to braid my daughter's hair. Even after, I washed and soaked it in apple cider vinegar. It still was soft. Nice price for the amount of hair. I would buy again.
Good quality hair. I got 9 bundles and that was enough for a full head of braids with some leftover. Super soft and light and easy to manage. I love the look.
It looks like they took 3 packs of hair and split it Into 9 packs don’t waste your money go to your local beauty supply and just buy hair from there
The hair is very thin. When doing my hair with the braiding hair. The hair was getting tangled and nappy fast. 😤
I really loved the hair ! And it was way more than I expected in the package.

I ordered hair from you 3 times.  And the reason why is because the hair was really soft. It moved like real hair. It didn't tangle at all.  I made a recent order and as soon as I took the hair out of the package.  I noticed a significant difference in quality. It felt really stiff. It doesn't move like real hair.  Its slightly poofier.  I'm wondering if you switched suppliers or this is a very bad batch.  But I will have to go elsewhere to get the quality hair that I once ordered.

reviews.t: VERY SMALL AND THIN BAGS OF HAIR
reviews.x: The size of the bags are VERY small and the hair is thin. You would do better going to your local beauty supply store, if possible, to get a standard sized bag of hair that is appropriately sized and priced. I was appalled at what I received and had to return.

I bought this hair as a first time getting braids, so i wasn’t too Sure in what to get my ir turned out amazing! My hair stylist said this hair was PERFECT for braiding and it felt so natural. We loved loved it!  She even bought some for herself.

I have been doing hair for over 5 years and this hair is ABSOLUTELY AMAZING. Great product, no smell, soft, came exactly as described and I had a pack left over when I was done! I will be ordering from here again.
Love this hair! This is my second time buying it and it’s good for medium sized box braids. Anything small and you’ll need a couple more packs of hair. Soft hair, stretched and doesn’t tangle easy
Not thick at all. Not worth the money. The photo and the actual product is different. I wouldn't suggest anyone buy this product. You do get 9 however, it equals out to 3 full bundles.
The hair is nice. I’m not a professional Braider but it did the job. I had minimal shedding and tangles. My scalp feels good. No foul smell or discomfort. Thanks for a quality product.
I did my own box braids for the first time with this hair. Super soft hair. It did get tangled a lot while braiding. I had enough hair to complete my whole.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the hair as soft and easy to manage.
Many customers report the 9-pack quantity is enough for a full head with leftovers and consider it good value.
Several reviewers note the hair has little to no smell.
Some customers feel the individual packs are thin or smaller than expected for the price.
A few reviewers report tangling or melting issues with the hair.
